_note: What fills a Mac's disk, what made it, and the best way to win the space back. paths: globs, ~ is home. regenerates: true when deleting it costs only a re-download or rebuild. action: delete | redirect | move | archive | report. redirect: how to point the tool somewhere else for good ({warm} is the warm drive's mount). Users add their own entries under knownItems in ~/.config/claude-kit/disk.json; an entry there with the same id replaces this one.

items.name: npx packages
items.creator: npx, including MCP servers started with npx
items.cost: MCP servers started with npx download again; close other Claude sessions first, since their servers run from here

items.name: pnpm store
items.creator: pnpm install
items.cost: pnpm hard-links from the store, which only works on the same drive: projects on another drive copy instead

items.name: Playwright browsers
items.creator: playwright install

redirect.how: export PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH={warm}/caches/ms-playwright  (in ~/.zshenv), then npx playwright install in each project

items.cost: each Playwright version needs its exact build; never delete mcp-chrome-* profiles

items.name: Hugging Face models
items.creator: transformers, diffusers, mlx and hf downloads

redirect.how: export HF_HOME={warm}/caches/huggingface  (in ~/.zshenv), then move the folder there

items.cost: models are large and slow to download again: move, don't delete

redirect.how: launchctl setenv OLLAMA_MODELS {warm}/models/ollama, restart Ollama, move the folder there
LM Studio → My Models → change the models folder

items.name: Whisper / MLX models
items.creator: whisper and mlx model downloads
items.delete: rm -rf the folder; models download again on next use

items.name: Xcode DerivedData
items.creator: Xcode builds
items.cost: the next Xcode build of each project is a full one

items.name: Xcode archives
items.creator: Xcode → Product → Archive
items.cost: old archives hold the dSYMs that symbolicate crash reports for shipped builds

items.name: iOS device support files
items.creator: Xcode, each time a device on a new OS connects
items.delete: delete the folders for OS versions you no longer debug on

items.name: Docker Desktop disk image
items.creator: Docker Desktop

redirect.how: Docker Desktop → Settings → Resources → Disk image location

items.cost: holds images, containers and VOLUMES (databases): prune build cache and images, never volumes

items.name: Colima VM disks
items.creator: colima / lima

redirect.how: export COLIMA_HOME={warm}/colima and LIMA_HOME={warm}/lima (in ~/.zshenv), stop colima, move the folders

items.cost: holds container volumes: move, don't delete

redirect.how: move it, then set ANDROID_HOME and the SDK path in Android Studio
export ANDROID_AVD_HOME={warm}/android-avd (in ~/.zshenv), then move the folder

items.name: VS Code caches
items.creator: VS Code
items.delete: quit VS Code, then delete these folders

items.name: VS Code workspace storage
items.creator: VS Code, one folder per workspace ever opened
items.delete: delete subfolders not modified in 90 days
items.cost: per-workspace UI state (open editors, extension state) for those workspaces

items.name: Chrome cache
items.creator: Google Chrome
items.delete: quit Chrome, then delete the folder

items.name: Chrome profiles
items.creator: Google Chrome (history, extensions, service workers, offline data)
items.cost: holds sign-ins and history; clear site data inside Chrome instead

items.name: Slack caches
items.creator: Slack
items.delete: quit Slack, then delete these folders

items.name: Claude Code session transcripts
items.creator: Claude Code, one JSONL per session
items.cost: session history and project memory; cleanupPeriodDays in settings trims old transcripts

items.name: Git worktrees
items.creator: Claude agents, /swarm, /plan, git worktree add
items.delete: ~/.claude-kit/scripts/worktree-sweep --apply (see the worktrees section of the report)

items.name: iPhone and iPad backups
items.creator: Finder device backups
items.cost: the only copy of a device's backup; delete old ones in Finder → device → Manage Backups

items.name: Messages attachments
items.creator: Messages
items.cost: turn on Messages in iCloud, or delete large conversations in Messages

items.name: Photos library
items.creator: Photos
items.cost: Photos → Settings → iCloud → Optimize Mac Storage, or move the library in Photos

items.name: Leftover iPhone/iPad restore files
items.creator: Finder or Apple Configurator updating or restoring a device (the firmware download is left behind)
items.cost: only while no device is being updated or restored

items.name: Codex runtime partial installs
items.creator: Codex runtime installs that never cleaned up
